top_5_findings.author: @Teknium
top_5_findings.summary: Hermes Agent now supports scaling both DEPTH and WIDTH with subagents. Teknium uncapped sub-agent spawn width and enabled spawn depth so sub-agents can recursively spawn more sub-agents. This is a major architectural breakthrough for complex multi-agent workflows.

top_5_findings.author: @NousResearch
top_5_findings.summary: GPT Image 2.0 is now available natively in Hermes Agent. Users can run update and select their image generation tool model. Official product integration from Nous Research.

top_5_findings.category: Hermes Agent ecosystem - native macOS GUI
top_5_findings.author: @QingQ77 / @awizemann
top_5_findings.summary: Scarf - a native macOS GUI for Hermes AI agent built in Swift. Supports managing multiple local and remote Hermes servers simultaneously, with real-time visualization of agent activity, sessions, configuration and system status. GitHub: https://github.com/awizemann/scarf

top_5_findings.author: @AIatAMD
top_5_findings.summary: AMD officially promoting Hermes Agent from NousResearch running locally on AMD Ryzen AI Max+ processors and Radeon GPUs using LMStudio. Major hardware vendor endorsement expanding Hermes beyond Apple Silicon and NVIDIA.

top_5_findings.author: @novasarc01
top_5_findings.summary: Hermes architecture integrates with the Atropos framework. The Hermes agent runtime has deep integration with Atropos, revealing more about the internal architecture and how sub-agent orchestration works at the framework level.
